Consequently, relying exclusively on single-pollutant models likely underestimates the developmental health threats of real-world plastic mixtures, highlighting the critical need to incorporate mixture interactions and sex-specific vulnerabilities into future environmental risk assessments.

title: Calvatia lilacina spores extract and engineered E. coli Nissle 1917 remodel the diabetic wound microenvironment through combined treatment.
authors: He Tangtang; Li Yan; Dong Tiantian; Yuan Tianjie; Min Wen et al.
summary_zh: 研究用紫色秃马勃孢子提取物联合工程化大肠杆菌Nissle 1917治疗糖尿病小鼠伤口，发现可加速愈合、重塑菌群并延长益生菌定植。
innovation: 提出以天然提取物作为胸苷递送载体维持工程化营养缺陷型益生菌定植的联合治疗策略 | 将食品源生物活性提取物与活体生物治疗相结合用于糖尿病伤口微环境重塑
study_object: 糖尿病db/db小鼠/全层切除伤口/工程化益生菌与提取物联合治疗及伤口菌群分析
abstract: Diabetic wound healing is severely impaired by persistent inflammation and microbial dysbiosis. The study presents a combinedfunctional ingredient system centered on an engineered thymidine-auxotrophic Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 strain (ThyA-/--EcN), whose survival and activity are sustained by the thymidine naturally present in Calvatia lilacina spore extract (CLSE). CLSE was chemically characterized by UHPLC-QTOF-MS, and its thymidine content was quantified as 4.1 mg/g by HPLC. In a full-thickness excisional wound model in diabetic db/db mice, CLSE alone accelerated wound healing, enhanced re-epithelialization and collagen deposition, and restructured the wound microbiota by increasing Escherichia-Shigella while suppressing Staphylococcus (SA). Notably, the combination of CLSE and ThyA-/--EcN significantly prolonged the colonization of the engineered probiotic in vivo compared to ThyA-/--EcN alone, an effect we hypothesize to be attributable, at least in part, to the thymidine provided by CLSE. This prolonged colonization, in combination with CLSE, boosted M2 macrophage polarization, enhanced fibroblast function, and strengthened the suppression of SA, which our in vitro data suggest may involve nutrient competition. The results demonstrate that CLSE not only directly improves wound healing but also acts as a natural thymidine delivery vehicle to unlock the full potential of ThyA-/--EcN, establishing a rationale for developing a food-derived bioactive extract-assisted live biotherapeutic strategy.

title: Probiotic consortium supplementation enhances sleep regulation via gut microbiota-derived short-chain fatty acid-mediated metabolic modulation.
authors: Seo Eunsol; Kim Min Gyeong; Kang Anna; Kang Min-Geun; Choi Youbin et al.
summary_zh: 研究益生菌联合补充通过肠道菌群短链脂肪酸代谢调节睡眠，小鼠实验显示延长睡眠并改善神经与免疫指标。
innovation: 揭示两株益生菌互补代谢途径汇聚于谷氨酰胺/谷氨酸轴以支持GABA合成 | 鉴定Dubosiella为与短链脂肪酸产生正相关的核心菌属 | 建立整合基因组、分子、代谢和微生物证据的系统级框架
study_object: 小鼠 + 粪便/肠道样本 + 基因组与代谢组及微生物组分析
abstract: Sleep regulation is increasingly recognized as a multifactorial process orchestrated by gut microbial metabolism and gut-brain axis signaling. Whereas pharmacological agents such as diazepam induce transient hypnotic effects through direct receptor modulation, probiotic interventions may elicit broader and more adaptive physiological benefits via host-microbiota metabolic crosstalk. Here, we investigated Limosilactobacillus fermentum SLAM_LAF05 (SLAM_LAF05) and Bifidobacterium longum SLAM_BIL02 (SLAM_BIL02), two rationally selected strains with complementary metabolic capacities, to delineate their synergistic roles in sleep regulation and systemic recovery. Genomic and metabolic profiling revealed that SLAM_LAF05 harbors the arginine deiminase pathway, while SLAM_BIL02 encodes genes for glutamine and glutamate biosynthesis; together, these routes converge on the glutamine/glutamate axis, potentially supporting γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) synthesis and cellular energy metabolism. In the mouse model, combined LF + BL supplementation prolonged sleep, stabilized sleep-wake architecture, enhanced motor performance, and reduced stress-associated biomarkers. Molecular and immunological analyses demonstrated upregulation of GABAergic genes, a shift toward inhibitory serotonergic signaling, reinforcement of intestinal barrier integrity, and attenuation of inflammatory responses. Microbiome profiling identified Dubosiella as a central taxon positively associated with short-chain fatty acid (SCFA) production, suggesting an association between microbial metabolic activity and host neurotransmitter balance. By integrating genomic, molecular, metabolic, and microbial evidence, this study establishes a systems-level framework illustrating how complementary probiotic metabolisms converge to modulate gut-brain communication, promote sleep stability, and support physiological resilience. These findings provide a conceptual and methodological foundation for investigating future multi-omics approaches to unravel the causal mechanisms underlying probiotic-mediated sleep regulation support the development of scientifically validated probiotic-based functional foods for promoting sleep health.

title: Dealcoholized muscadine wine improved skin elasticity and oxidative stress biomarkers without affecting gut microbiome in women over 40 in a randomized controlled trial.
authors: Christman Lindsey; Mai Chuqiao; Gu Liwei
summary_zh: 随机交叉试验发现，去醇马斯卡丁葡萄酒可改善40岁以上女性皮肤弹性和氧化应激标志物，但不影响肠道菌群。
innovation: 研究去醇马斯卡丁葡萄酒对皮肤健康、氧化应激和肠道菌群的影响 | 采用随机单盲交叉设计 | 使用鸟枪法测序分析肠道菌群
limitation: 样本量较小（17人） | 干预时间较短（6周）
study_object: 人类女性/粪便/鸟枪法测序
abstract: Muscadine wine has a unique polyphenol profile distinct from that of common wine, and limited research exists on its health benefits. This study aimed to investigate the effects of intake of dealcoholized muscadine wine (DMW) on skin health, oxidative stress, inflammatory biomarkers, and the gut microbiome. Seventeen healthy women were randomly assigned to consume 300 mL of DMW or a placebo daily for 6 weeks, separated by a 3-week washout period, in a randomized, single-blinded, crossover design. Skin health parameters were measured on the face and forearm. Oxidative stress and inflammatory biomarkers were assessed in plasma. Fecal bacterial DNA was sequenced using shotgun sequencing. DMW did not affect UVB-induced erythema compared to placebo. However, it significantly decreased transepidermal water loss and increased facial gross elasticity. Skin elasticity significantly improved on the forearm, whereas other skin parameters were not affected. DMW significantly decreased plasma levels of matrix metalloproteinase-9 and advanced glycation end products compared with placebo. However, the abundance, diversity, and functions of the gut microbiome were not affected. Polyphenol-rich DMW administered for six weeks improved certain skin health parameters and reduced oxidative and inflammatory stress, without affecting the gut microbiome in healthy women.

title: DBAASP V4: condition-resolved bioactivity and chemical structures for data-driven peptide and peptidomimetic discovery.
authors: Pirtskhalava Malak; Alimbarashvili Evgenia; Grigolava Maia; Chubinidze Mindia; Vishnepolsky Boris et al.
summary_zh: DBAASP v4数据库整合超2.5万条肽及拟肽的定量生物活性与结构数据，支持机器学习预测与设计。
innovation: 从序列中心扩展为结构感知数据库，系统引入SMILES表示 | 新增抗生物膜、协同记录及超9200条分子动力学轨迹 | 提供条件分辨数据支持监督学习与遗传算法代理适应度函数
study_object: 肽和拟肽数据库（多来源），未指定宿主/环境或样本类型
abstract: The current peptide renaissance-driven by metagenomic and proteomic mining, molecular de-extinction, protein language models, and generative or evolutionary design-is producing millions of candidates, but useful machine learning depends on experimentally anchored, context-rich labels. The Database of Antimicrobial Activity and Structure of Peptides (DBAASP) is a manually curated resource linking peptides and peptidomimetics to quantitative antimicrobial, antibiofilm, anticancer, hemolytic, and mammalian-cell cytotoxicity measurements and their experimental conditions. DBAASP v4 contains >25 000 entries and extends the resource from a sequence-centered database to a structure-aware repository. Major additions include systematic SMILES representations, enhanced annotation of intrachain bonds and ring architectures, dedicated antibiofilm, and synergy records, PubChem links, >9200 molecular-dynamics trajectories, and new prediction services. The condition-resolved data support supervised learning, strain-, and target-specific models, model calibration, and surrogate fitness functions for genetic algorithms. SMILES representations further enable modeling of noncanonical peptides and peptidomimetics that cannot be adequately described by sequence alone. DBAASP therefore complements large peptide catalogues by providing the experimentally curated activity and structure layers, needed to convert sequence information into testable predictions, design, and optimization of biologically active compounds. DBAASP v4 is freely available at https://dbaasp.org.

title: Pathobiont-directed mucosal immunotherapy targets Ruminococcus gnavus and remodels host-microbiota interactions in colitis.
authors: Wang Zhaoyi; Huang Linlin; Liu Xiaoxia; Cheng Xin; Liang Yuting et al.
summary_zh: 通过临床菌群分析和动物实验，鉴定Rg为UC相关致病共生菌，并设计口服免疫疗法CP-EV@Ca选择性抑制Rg、缓解结肠炎。
innovation: 开发口服菌群导向黏膜免疫疗法CP-EV@Ca，结合病原特异性免疫靶向与氧化还原调节 | 诱导Rg特异性sIgA，增强免疫包被并抑制Rg扩增 | 在急慢性结肠炎模型中疗效优于5-ASA
study_object: 人类肠道菌群（IBD患者）及结肠炎动物模型；黏膜免疫疗法
disease: 溃疡性结肠炎（UC）和结肠炎
abstract: Disease-associated pathobionts are recurrently enriched in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), yet their causal contribution and selective therapeutic control remain incompletely defined. Here, through clinical microbiome profiling and causal animal studies, we identified Ruminococcus gnavus (Rg) as a key ulcerative colitis (UC)-associated pathobiont whose abundance positively correlates with intestinal oxidative stress and inflammatory levels. To selectively constrain Rg, we engineered CP-EV@Ca, an oral microbiota-directed mucosal immunotherapy that combines pathogen-specific immune targeting with redox modulation. CP-EV@Ca enhanced mucosal antigen presentation, promoted T follicular helper cell-germinal-center B-cell responses and induced robust Rg-specific secretory IgA (sIgA). CP-EV@Ca-induced mucosal immune responses, including enhanced Rg-specific sIgA production, were associated with increased immune coating and reduced Rg expansion. In both acute and chronic colitis models, CP-EV@Ca outperformed 5-aminosalicylic acid (5-ASA), suppressing inflammation and restoring microbial, epithelial and immune homeostasis. These findings demonstrate that pathobiont-specific mucosal immunity can be harnessed to selectively constrain disease-associated bacteria and restore intestinal homeostasis.

title: Methanogenic archaea Methanobrevibacter smithii and Methanosphaera stadtmanae promote mucosal homeostasis and protect from colitis.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
authors: Byrd Emily E; Harris Benjamin W; Zhang Hongpan; Warren W Elise; Kolli Sree H et al.
summary_zh: 本研究通过无菌及抗生素处理小鼠模型，发现两种人类产甲烷古菌可增强肠上皮屏障、扩增调节性T细胞并预防结肠炎。
innovation: 揭示产甲烷古菌促进结肠健康的功能 | 发现MSm和MSt通过非冗余机制保护结肠炎 | 证明MSt保护依赖适应性免疫而MSm部分不依赖
limitation: 研究仅基于小鼠模型，向人类疾病的转化尚未确立
study_object: 小鼠/肠道/无菌与悉生及抗生素处理SPF模型
abstract: The intestinal microbiota is a critical determinant of mucosal homeostasis, yet the functional contributions of Archaea-which constitute up to 10% of the anaerobic community-remain largely undefined. Here, we provide evidence that the human methanogens Methanobrevibacter smithii (MSm) and Methanosphaera stadtmanae (MSt) promote colonic health. Transcriptomic analysis of germ-free mice reveals that MSm and MSt induce distinct colonic programs important for epithelial integrity. Using gnotobiotic and antibiotic-treated specific-pathogen-free mouse models, we show that MSm and MSt reinforce the epithelial barrier, characterized by increased goblet cell expansion, mucus thickening, and enhanced epithelial regeneration. Furthermore, methanogens expand Foxp3+ regulatory T cell (Treg) populations without inducing pro-inflammatory TH17 responses. Notably, MSm and MSt protect against dextran sodium sulfate-induced colitis. While MSt-mediated protection requires adaptive immunity, MSm retains partial efficacy in lymphocyte-deficient mice, revealing nonredundant protective mechanisms. These findings indicate that methanogenic archaea promote mucosal integrity during host association and suggest that methanogens may hold therapeutic potential for inflammatory bowel disease, though translation to human disease remains to be established.

title: Aerobic exercise training alters gastrointestinal microbiota and enhances exercise capacity in UM-HET3 mice.
authors: Smith Casandra; Garza Kiara; Azari Hushyar; Vellers Heather; Abdelrahman Mostafa et al.
summary_zh: 研究4周有氧运动训练对UM-HET3小鼠肠道菌群的影响，发现训练改变菌群组成并与运动能力相关。
innovation: 在遗传异质性UM-HET3小鼠中研究有氧运动对肠道菌群的影响 | 结合身体成分和运动能力评估菌群变化关联
limitation: α多样性差异未达统计学显著 | 未描述
study_object: UM-HET3小鼠/粪便/16S rRNA基因测序
sample_size: n=33（SED n=16，ET n=17）；粪便测序SED n=13，ET n=13
abstract: Aerobic exercise attenuates age-related physiological decline, potentially through favorable modulation of gut microbiota diversity. The purpose of this study was to characterize aerobic exercise training (ET)-induced alterations in the gut microbiome of aging, genetically heterogeneous UM-HET3 mice and examine associations between microbial shifts and changes in body composition (body weight, lean mass, and fat mass) and exercise capacity (total work, distance, and duration). Male UM-HET3 mice were assigned to sedentary (SED; n = 16) or ET (n = 17) groups. ET mice trained 5 days per week for 4 weeks at 65% of maximal work output. Body composition and exercise capacity were assessed before and after the intervention. Post-intervention fecal samples were analyzed by 16S rRNA gene sequencing (SED, n = 13; ET, n = 13). ASVs were taxonomically classified using QIIME2 with the SILVA 138.1 reference database. Alpha and beta diversity analyses were conducted in R, and Spearman's correlations assessed relationships between phylum-level abundances and physiological outcomes. ET mice exhibited greater alpha diversity, with a higher median richness (219.5), although differences were not statistically significant. Principal coordinate analysis of beta diversity demonstrated significant separation between groups (P = 0.01), indicating distinct microbial community composition. At the phylum level, ET was associated with modest shifts in gut microbial composition, characterized by higher relative abundances of Firmicutes and Verrucomicrobiota and lower abundances of Bacteroidota and Desulfobacterota compared to SED mice. Collectively, these findings indicate that aerobic exercise training induces distinct shifts in gut microbiota composition in middle-aged UM-HET3 mice despite underlying genetic heterogeneity.

title: Predictive biomarkers in cancer immunotherapy for genitourinary malignancies.
authors: Paulet Alexandra; Shtembari Kristian; Izzi Martina; Calandrelli Chiara; Mancini Silvia et al.
summary_zh: 综述泌尿生殖系统癌症免疫治疗预测生物标志物，涵盖现有与新兴标志物及未来方向。
innovation: 系统整合微生物组影响等多维度生物标志物 | 提出复合生物标志物与人工智能等未来方向
study_object: 人类/泌尿生殖系统肿瘤/综述
disease: 肾细胞癌、尿路上皮癌、前列腺癌
abstract: Immunotherapy has transformed the management of genitourinary cancers, offering durable responses in selected patient groups. However, the clinical benefit of immune checkpoint inhibitors varies significantly across renal cell carcinoma, urothelial carcinoma, and prostate cancer, underscoring the need for reliable predictive biomarkers. This review summarizes current knowledge on established and emerging biomarkers, including PD L1 expression, tumor mutational burden, molecular subtypes, genomic alterations, tumor microenvironment characteristics, circulating biomarkers, microbiome influences, and multi omic integrative approaches. We discuss their potential clinical relevance, limitations, and applicability across different tumor types. Future directions emphasize the development of composite biomarkers, standardization of testing platforms, real time monitoring strategies, and the integration of advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and spatial profiling. Understanding and validating these biomarkers will be essential for optimizing personalized immunotherapy in genitourinary cancers.

title: Multidisciplinary Delphi consensus statement on minimal standards for clinical metadata and end points in microbiome studies.
authors: Schierwagen Robert; Carraturo Federica; Iyappan Anandhi; Brol Maximilian J; Druart Celine et al.
summary_zh: 通过两轮德尔菲调查，专家就肠道微生物组临床研究的元数据、采样、数据分析和临床终点等最低标准达成15条建议。
innovation: 采用两轮德尔菲调查在HMA联盟框架下制定微生物组临床研究最低标准 | 提出15条具体建议以促进微生物组临床研究的协调统一
limitation: 建议主要聚焦肠道微生物组及与胃肠道和肠-器官轴相关疾病，可能不适用于其他部位微生物组研究
study_object: 人类肠道微生物组临床研究
disease: 与胃肠道和肠-器官轴相关的疾病
sample_size: 第一轮72名专家，第二轮61名专家
abstract: The lack of harmonization for microbiome-based clinical studies represents a critical issue for microbiome researchers and stakeholders, although microbiome research and clinical studies on the gut microbiome have been intensively conducted for more than a decade. The selection of a minimum metadata set to be analysed and reported during clinical studies with microbiome outcomes, the identification of reference materials, the definition of standardized sampling procedures and data analysis protocols, and the choice of unified clinical end points are still lacking. The two-round Delphi survey, conducted within the framework of the Horizon Europe Human Microbiome Action (HMA) consortium, aimed to standardize metadata collection, sampling procedures, data generation and sharing, and standard operating procedures for aspects of gut microbiome-based clinical studies beyond outcomes. The process involved 72 scientists and experts worldwide in the first round and 61 experts in the second round, with an 85% participation rate from the first to the second round. On the basis of the outcome of the Delphi survey, the HMA consortium provided 15 recommendations that might be taken up by the community at large to promote coherence and harmonization in the way microbiome clinical research is and will be performed. The recommendations mainly focus on the gut microbiome and diseases associated with the gastrointestinal tract and gut-organ axes.

title: Associating the oral microbiome across the head and neck cancer continuum: a scoping review.
authors: Beacher Nicholas G; Riggio Marcello; Khan Adil; Butcher Mark C; Delaney Chris et al.
summary_zh: 本范围综述系统检索105项研究，发现口腔微生物与头颈癌关联高度异质，需更高质量大样本研究。
innovation: 系统梳理口腔微生物在头颈癌风险至预后全 continuum 的研究 | 总结微生物丰度变化方向及常用技术
limitation: 纳入研究样本量普遍较小（n=5-499） | 多数研究仅分析单一临床样本
study_object: 人类口腔样本（唾液/口腔拭子等） + 头颈癌患者 + 微生物组测序（以Illumina技术为主）
disease: 头颈癌（口腔癌、口咽癌、喉癌）
abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Head and neck cancers (HNC) comprise oral cavity, oropharynx and larynx tumors. The role of the oral microbiome across the continuum from risk to diagnostic stage and outcomes is not well understood.
METHODS: Systematic searches were undertaken; Ovid MEDLINE and Embase, Web of Science and Open Grey (2011-2024), title/abstracts were screened in duplicate. Data were collected using an extraction template and subsequently descriptively analyzed.
RESULTS: There were 105 studies included, most from Asia (n = 64, 61%), focusing on oral cavity cancer (n = 58, 55%). Sample sizes were generally small (ranging n = 5-499), with age mainly >50-years (mean n = 102, 97%), and male (n = 4044, 75%). Stage was reported in 63 studies (60%) and survival in 18 (17%). Single clinical sample's were most frequently analyzed (n = 94, 90%). DNA extraction method and primers varied but Illumina technologies were most often employed (n = 73, 70%). Fusobacterium nucleatum most frequently increased in abundance (n = 7, 7%), while Haemophilus parainfluenzae (n = 9, 9%) most frequently decreased in abundance. Over half of studies (n = 58, 55%) provided accessible links to open data.
CONCLUSIONS: The abundance of microorganisms in relation to HNC is highly variable. Further large higher quality studies are required to assess the role of microbiome HNC stage, site, and prognosis.

title: Persistent microbial-derived material accumulates after brain injury and associates with chronic neuroinflammation.
authors: Yang Hongmei; Shyong Olivia; Wu Limin; Marcet Evan; Dillon Brianne et al.
summary_zh: 研究检测慢性创伤性脑病（CTE）和实验性脑损伤中微生物来源物质PNAG，发现其持续积累并与慢性神经炎症相关，减少PNAG可改善结局。
innovation: 首次在人类CTE脑组织和实验性TBI中检测到微生物多糖PNAG的积累 | 证明PNAG与pTau共定位且呈疾病阶段依赖性 | 通过主动疫苗接种减少脑内PNAG并改善长期运动结局
study_object: 人类尸检脑组织和小鼠脑组织；宿主脑组织样本；微生物多糖检测、动物实验和免疫干预
disease: 慢性创伤性脑病（CTE）和创伤性脑损伤（TBI）
abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is associated with chronic neurodegenerative sequelae, including chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), but mechanisms sustaining long-term neuroinflammation in the injured brain remain unclear. Persistent, poorly cleared biological material has been proposed as a driver of chronic inflammation. This study tested whether microbial-derived material is present in CTE and experimental brain injury, and whether reducing such material is associated with improved outcomes.
METHODS: Post-mortem brain tissue from individuals with CTE and controls was analyzed for the microbial polysaccharide poly-N-acetyl-glucosamine (PNAG) and phosphorylated tau (pTau). Mice were subjected to single and repetitive closed head injury (CHI), with assessment of brain PNAG and tau accumulation, behavior, and neuropathology. Purified PNAG was administered intracerebrally to evaluate biological effects. Passive antibody treatment and active vaccination targeting PNAG were used to determine whether reducing brain PNAG altered outcomes after CHI.
RESULTS: PNAG accumulated in human CTE brains in a disease stage-dependent manner and colocalized with pTau. In mice, PNAG rapidly accumulated across multiple brain regions after CHI and remained elevated at two weeks. Intracerebral administration of purified PNAG induced physiological and behavioral deficits that differed by sex, whereas a lower dose produced no detectable behavioral deficits. Passive anti-PNAG antibody treatment reduced brain PNAG with limited functional benefit, whereas active vaccination in adolescence and early adulthood reduced brain PNAG accumulation and IBA1 immunoreactivity, was associated with lower pTau accumulation, and improved long-term motor outcomes one year after repetitive CHI.
CONCLUSIONS: Persistent microbial-derived material is detectable in human CTE and experimental TBI. Reduction of PNAG-associated microbial-derived material is associated with attenuation of chronic neuroinflammation, pathological tau accumulation, and improved long-term neurological outcomes, supporting a model in which persistent microbial-derived material may contribute to chronic post-traumatic neuroinflammation.

title: Bacteria inside kidney tumors associate with myeloid inflammation and disease progression: A TRACERx Renal study.
authors: Martin Alice C; Cattin Anne-Laure; Lockwood Parise K; Zepeda-Rivera Martha A; Becker Clara et al.
summary_zh: 研究揭示ccRCC肿瘤内细菌分布及其与髓系炎症和疾病进展的关联，发现Cutibacterium富集于肿瘤中心并与预后不良相关。
innovation: 首次在ccRCC中通过培养证实活菌存在并多区域分析瘤内分布 | 结合空间转录组和体外实验验证细菌与中性粒细胞炎症的关联 | 在两个独立队列中验证细菌作为预后标志物
study_object: 肾透明细胞癌患者/肿瘤组织/微生物组与转录组测序
sample_size: TRACERx队列143例患者616样本；TCGA队列511例患者511样本
abstract:
BACKGROUND: Intratumoral bacteria are increasingly recognized as active contributors to neutrophil-driven inflammation and disease progression in solid tumors. Yet, in clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC), where myeloid inflammation is a key feature of aggressive disease, live bacterial presence, their intratumoral distribution, and interaction with the tumor microenvironment remain unexplored.
METHODS: We genetically characterized the microbiome of primary ccRCC tumors across two independent cohorts (TRACERx: 616 samples, 143 patients; The Cancer Genome Atlas [TCGA]: 511 samples and patients), confirming live bacterial presence through culture. Multi-regional sampling enabled within-tumor analysis of bacterial distribution. Associations with the tumor microenvironment were explored at scale using bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) across both cohorts and corroborated in depth through spatial transcriptomics and in vitro infection assays.
FINDINGS: Across both cohorts, the commensal Cutibacterium emerged as the dominant genus, accumulating in discrete niches enriched toward the tumor center and associating with more advanced (TRACERx p = 0.024; TCGA p = 0.0011) tumors and shorter progression-free survival (TRACERx p = 0.0022; TCGA p = 4.4 × 10-4). Both across and within tumors, Cutibacterium accumulation associated with neutrophil recruitment and myeloid inflammation. In vitro, Cutibacterium induced sustained expression of neutrophil-attracting chemokines in macrophages, recapitulating patient tumor findings.
CONCLUSIONS: These findings establish intratumoral bacteria as novel prognostic components of the ccRCC tumor microenvironment and suggest an active role in shaping local myeloid inflammation, laying the groundwork for investigating their potential as therapeutic targets.
FUNDING: This work was supported by the Francis Crick Institute (Cancer Research UK, MRC, Wellcome Trust). TRACERx Renal is funded by Cancer Research UK (C50947/A18176).

title: Gut virome remodeling after fecal microbiota transplantation is associated with virus-bacteria co-variation and metabolic response in obesity and type 2 diabetes.
authors: Jiang Hui; Peng Ye; Lam Brian; Yang Keli; Lin Yu et al.
summary_zh: 通过病毒样颗粒富集宏基因组测序研究肥胖合并2型糖尿病患者粪菌移植后肠道病毒组变化，发现病毒组变化与细菌组变化及代谢应答相关。
innovation: 采用VLP富集宏基因组测序结合bulk-DNA宏基因组测序纵向分析FMT后病毒组变化 | 发现FMT后病毒组变化区分LDL应答者与非应答者的准确率与细菌组相当 | 揭示供体来源病毒序列定植及病毒-细菌协同关联与临床代谢应答相关
study_object: 肥胖合并2型糖尿病患者/人类/粪便样本/病毒样颗粒富集宏基因组测序与bulk-DNA宏基因组测序
abstract: Fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) modifies gut bacterial composition and improves metabolic outcomes in subjects with obesity and type 2 diabetes (ObT2), but bacterial changes alone do not fully explain the heterogeneity in clinical response. We performed virus-like particle (VLP)-enriched metagenomic sequencing coupled with bulk-DNA metagenomic sequencing on longitudinal fecal samples from a randomized controlled FMT trial in ObT2. Using random forest classification, post-FMT virome changes showed accuracy comparable to bacteriome changes (84.8% vs 81.4%) in distinguishing LDL responders from non-responders. Donor-derived viral contig engraftment was detected in 64.7% (11/17) of recipients receiving FMT alone and 58.8% (10/17) receiving FMT with lifestyle intervention (LSI), versus 5.6% (1/18) in the sham with LSI group. FMT was associated with increased virome diversity, compositional shifts toward the donor virome, and coordinated virus-bacteria associations, with most responsive viral contigs classified as Caudoviricetes. FMT-responsive viral contigs that were shared between the two FMT groups were predicted to infect Roseburia and Bifidobacterium, while contigs associated with clinical responses were predicted to infect Escherichia, Roseburia, Blautia, and Enterococcus. These findings suggest that the gut virome is a complementary ecological component associated with FMT responses and metabolic outcomes in ObT2.

title: From Clinical Question to Defensible Inference: A Decision Framework for Integrated Gut Microbiome-Metabolome Studies.
journal: Romanian journal of internal medicine = Revue roumaine de medecine interne
authors: Manciulea Profir Monica; Ionescu Ruxandra F; Popescu Roşu Oana A; Stancu Alin Constantin; Cucu Ioana et al.
summary_zh: 本文提出一个五阶段决策框架，将肠道微生物组-代谢组整合研究的设计选择与预期科学或临床声明相连接，以验证水平限定推断强度。
innovation: 提出五阶段决策框架，从定义预期声明出发连接分析选择与验证水平 | 明确以分析链中最弱验证组件作为可允许声明的上限，而非仅由技术选择决定 | 通过两个设计示例说明该框架的实际应用
study_object: 肠道微生物组与代谢组（人体肠道样本） | 多组学整合研究（综述与决策框架）
abstract: The rapid expansion of microbiome and metabolome technologies has transformed the study of host-microbial interactions, but methodological choices are still often driven by technical availability rather than by the question and intended claim. This review examines how biological compartment, microbiome profiling, metabolomics platform, data-integration strategy and validation determine the strength of inference in integrated gut microbiome-metabolome research. We distinguish descriptive association from functional interpretation, clinical prediction and causal evidence, and identify the analytical safeguards required for credible biomarker development. We then propose a five-stage decision framework that begins with definition of the intended scientific or clinical claim, links that claim to compartment and analytical resolution, selects integration according to purpose, and limits interpretation to the achieved validation level. Building on recent calls for question-driven multi-omics integration, its practical contribution is to connect prospective design choices to the intended claim and make the weakest validated component of the analytical chain - rather than technology choice alone - the explicit ceiling for the permissible claim, illustrated by two worked design examples. This question-driven approach is intended to improve design transparency, reproducibility and the responsible clinical translation of integrated microbiome-metabolome studies.

title: Impact of YAQ001 on the Gut Microbiome, Permeability and Markers of Systemic Inflammation in Patients With Cirrhosis.
journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
authors: Liu Jinxia; Garcia-Guevara Fernando; Macnaughtan Jane; Jin Yi; Ferret-Miñana Ainhoa et al.
summary_zh: 随机双盲试验发现YAQ001可改变肝硬化患者肠道菌群组成，降低毒力基因和炎症标志物，体外抑制肺炎克雷伯菌生物膜。
innovation: 研究新型非吸收性肠道限制性多孔碳珠吸附剂YAQ001对肝硬化患者肠道微生物组的影响 | 发现YAQ001降低与感染和不良预后相关的细菌丰度及抗生素耐药基因 | 体外证实YAQ001抑制肺炎克雷伯菌生物膜形成
limitation: 样本量较小（28例），且为探索性亚组分析；部分结果为趋势性变化，需进一步验证
study_object: 肝硬化患者/肠道/微生物组测序
abstract:
BACKGROUND & AIMS: YAQ001 is a novel, non-absorbable, gut-restricted, multiporous, carbon bead adsorbent. Pre-clinical studies and a clinical trial suggested its therapeutic potential and safety in patients with cirrhosis. This substudy aimed to explore the effects of YAQ001 on the gut microbiome and their exploratory association with biomarkers of gut permeability and systemic inflammation.
METHODS: Twenty-eight-patients with cirrhosis were randomized (double-blind) to receive YAQ001 (4 g once daily) or placebo. Gut microbiome and biomarkers of inflammation and gut permeability were assessed at baseline, after 4 and 12 weeks. Changes in biomarkers and relationship with microbiome composition and gene profiling were assessed. The effect of YAQ001 on Klebsiella pneumoniae biofilms was assessed in vitro.
RESULTS: Overall alpha and beta diversity remained unaltered. YAQ001 increased the abundance of bacteria associated with improved gut health such as Adlercreutzia equolifaciens, a bacterium commonly depleted in liver disease, and decreased the abundance of bacteria associated with infections and poor outcomes such as Klebsiella pneumonia, and Streptococcus mutans. YAQ001 impacted positively on virulence factors such as siderophores, fimbriae structures, and lipopolysaccharides that are associated with inflammation and invasion. Antibiotic resistance genes decreased significantly in the YAQ001 group. These changes were associated with a reduction in markers of gut permeability and systemic inflammation. YAQ001 prevented K. pneumoniae biofilms in vitro.
CONCLUSION: YAQ001 was associated with favourable compositional shifts and trends towards reduced virulence-related gene signatures in the gut microbiome, alongside trends towards improved inflammatory biomarkers. The in vitro anti-biofilm effect of YAQ001 warrants further mechanistic investigation. The findings position YAQ001 as a potential microbiome therapeutic.

title: Discovery and characterization of miranthins, "Trojan horse" antibiotic modulators of bacterial composition in the oral microbiome.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
authors: Dalvano Brielle E; Covington Brett C; Seyedsayamdost Mohammad R
summary_zh: 研究口腔早期定植菌轻链球菌产生的miranthins家族肽类天然产物，发现其经Ami转运体进入细胞后被氨基肽酶N激活，抑制核糖体翻译以抑制竞争链球菌生长。
innovation: 鉴定并结构表征了含Asp-Cys β-碳硫醚大环的miranthins家族肽类天然产物 | 揭示miranthins作为“特洛伊木马”抗生素通过Ami寡肽转运体进入敏感细胞并被氨基肽酶N水解激活的机制 | 发现miranthins为窄谱抗生素，可能帮助轻链球菌调节口腔微生物群落动态
study_object: 口腔/轻链球菌/肽类天然产物
abstract: Bacteria of the human microbiota encode an abundance of natural products that likely mediate bacterial competition, local colonization patterns, and human health and disease. However, very few of these compounds have been identified and characterized to date. During our investigation of Streptococcus mitis, an important early colonizer of the oral cavity, we identified and structurally characterized a family of peptide natural products, termed miranthins herein, that contain an unusual macrocycle formed by an Asp-Cys β-carbon thioether crosslink. We determined that the most abundantly secreted miranthin is a "Trojan horse" antibiotic that enters sensitive cells via the Ami oligopeptide transporter, is hydrolyzed and activated by aminopeptidase N, and subsequently inhibits ribosomal translation to curb the growth of streptococcal competitors. The miranthins are narrow-spectrum antibiotics that could enable S. mitis to modulate community dynamics in the oral cavity, highlighting the importance of peptide natural products in interspecies competition in the microbiome.

title: Effects of Protein Intake on Gut Microbiota in Physically Active Individuals: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
authors: Bao Zihan; Jiao Meng; Zhao Mengqi; Huang Fang-Yingzi; Liu Yunyang et al.
summary_zh: 系统评价与荟萃分析发现，蛋白质摄入可提高运动活跃人群肠道菌群多样性，但会减少双歧杆菌等有益菌。
innovation: 首次系统评价并荟萃分析蛋白质摄入对运动活跃个体肠道菌群的影响 | 发现蛋白质剂量与α多样性效应呈U型关联，最低点在1.5-2.0 g/kg/d | 通过亚组分析揭示年龄、BMI、干预时长、蛋白质剂量及运动方式与强度对菌群效应的调节作用
study_object: 运动活跃个体 + 肠道菌群样本 + 系统评价与荟萃分析
abstract:
CONTEXT: Protein (PRO) intake supports exercise adaptation and recovery, but its effects on gut microbiota (GM) in physically active individuals remain inconsistent across doses, PRO sources, and exercise conditions.
OBJECTIVE: To systematically evaluate and meta-analyze the effects of PRO intake on GM in physically active individuals.
DATA SOURCES: The PubMed, EBSCOhost, the Cochrane Library, and Web of Science databases were searched through June 2026. Reference lists of relevant studies and reviews were also examined.
DATA EXTRACTION: Two reviewers independently screened records and extracted study, participant, intervention, and outcome data. Eligible studies quantified PRO intake, included an exercise or physical-activity component, and reported extractable GM outcomes. Risk of bias and evidence certainty were assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2.0 tool and Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluation approach, respectively.
DATA ANALYSIS: Random-effects meta-analyses using Hedges' g, subgroup analyses, and meta-regression were performed. Eighteen studies (n = 819 participants) were included. Protein intake significantly increased the Shannon and Chao1 indices but not the Simpson index or observed operational taxonomic units (OTUs). A significant U-shaped association was observed between PRO dose and the α-diversity effect size, with the fitted curve reaching its lowest point at 1.5-2.0 g kg-1 d-1. Protein intake significantly decreased populations of Actinobacteria, Bifidobacterium, and Firmicutes, and the Firmicutes to Bacteroidetes ratio, and increased Bacteroidetes numbers. Subgroup findings suggested that age, body mass index, intervention duration, PRO dose, and exercise modality and intensity moderated the effects on Shannon diversity and Bifidobacterium abundance.
CONCLUSIONS: Protein intake appears to improve gut microbial diversity in physically active individuals but may also induce notable shifts in beneficial taxa, particularly reductions in Bifidobacterium. Future studies should prioritize individualized microbiome-informed strategies, evaluate long-term safety, and clarify the ecological impact of different PRO sources to optimize exercise nutrition interventions.
SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: PROSPERO registration No. CRD420261288197.

title: Acetate modulates host physiology and bacterial energetics to improve antibiotic efficacy during obesity-associated infection.
authors: Hussain Arsalan; Bhardwaj Prateek; Ray Ashish Kumar; Singh Aakash; Sett Abhiroop et al.
summary_zh: 比较肥胖与健康小鼠感染鲍曼不动杆菌，发现肥胖相关乙酸耗竭致抗生素失效，补乙酸可恢复疗效。
innovation: 揭示肥胖驱动的微生物乙酸耗竭是独立于细菌耐药性的抗生素治疗失败新决定因素 | 乙酸补充通过重塑肠道菌群、恢复先天免疫并直接增敏细菌，单干预靶向宿主-病原-微生物组轴 | 提出乙酸与氨基糖苷类联合治疗肥胖相关革兰阴性感染的新策略
study_object: 小鼠/肠道微生物组与鲍曼不动杆菌感染模型/机制比较与干预实验
abstract:
UNLABELLED: Antibiotic efficacy is conventionally attributed to the susceptibility of the infecting pathogen. However, obese patients experience disproportionately poor infection outcomes despite receiving antibiotics to which pathogens remain genetically susceptible. These observations suggest that host-associated factors can influence treatment outcomes independently of the bacterial genotype, although the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Using a mechanistic comparison of diet-induced obese and healthy mice infected with Acinetobacter baumannii, we demonstrate that the effect of antibiotics is not solely a property of the pathogen but can be governed by a gut microbiota-derived metabolite acting on both host immunity and bacterial physiology. We identify obesity-associated acetate depletion as a key driver of antibiotic treatment failure, linking gut microbial metabolism to antibiotic activity during infection. We observed that this depletion impaired innate immune activation, reducing cytokine responses and neutrophil-mediated bacterial clearance. Under these conditions, A. baumannii displayed enhanced tolerance to bactericidal antibiotics, particularly tobramycin. Given these findings, we investigated whether acetate could be leveraged therapeutically to restore antibiotic efficacy. We observed that oral acetate supplementation remodeled the dysbiotic microbiome, whereas systemic acetate restored innate immune competence and neutrophil-mediated bacterial clearance. Most importantly, acetate reversed antibiotic tolerance and restored aminoglycoside killing by directly sensitizing host-induced tolerant bacterial populations. Mechanistically, acetate directly reprogrammed bacterial physiology to enhance aminoglycoside-mediated killing. Combined acetate-tobramycin treatment resulted in eradication of tolerant populations and markedly improved bacterial clearance in vivo. Our findings establish a mechanistic link between host metabolic state and antibiotic efficacy and identify acetate as a therapeutic intervention for obesity-associated gram-negative infections.
IMPORTANCE: Antibiotic treatment failure in obese patients remains poorly understood and therapeutically unaddressed. This study reveals that host metabolic state can control antibiotic response through a gut microbiota-derived metabolite that acts on both host defense and bacterial physiology. We identify obesity-driven depletion of microbiota-derived acetate as a previously unrecognized determinant of antibiotic failure, operating independently of bacterial resistance. By simultaneously restoring gut microbial balance, rescuing impaired innate immunity, and directly sensitizing pathogens to aminoglycoside killing through bacterial membrane alteration, acetate supplementation addresses the host-pathogen-microbiome axis through a single intervention. Given its established clinical safety, acetate represents a compelling combination therapy alongside aminoglycosides in obesity-associated gram-negative infections in a population for which host-directed treatment strategies are currently limited.

title: Circulating free bacterial DNA as a novel biomarker for monitoring therapy response in patients with advanced pancreatic cancer.
authors: Surendran Sai Agash; Guenther Michael; Nemati Niloofar; Incera Marina Lopez; Zhang Danmei et al.
summary_zh: 本研究评估循环游离细菌DNA动态变化能否预测晚期胰腺癌患者化疗反应，发现其变化与无进展生存和总生存相关，且预测作用因治疗方案而异。
innovation: 首次评估循环游离细菌DNA动态作为晚期胰腺癌化疗反应监测的生物标志物 | 发现该标志物的预测作用具有治疗依赖性，提示治疗特异的宿主-微生物-肿瘤相互作用
limitation: 探索性队列样本量小（13例） | 需前瞻性验证
study_object: 胰腺癌患者/血清/循环游离细菌DNA测序分析
sample_size: 探索队列13例，验证队列47例
abstract:
BACKGROUND: Monitoring therapy response in pancreatic cancer (PDAC) remains challenging. The microbiome affects therapy efficacy, but its role in response prediction is unclear. We assessed whether changes in circulating free bacterial DNA (cfbDNA) levels predict outcome of advanced PDAC (aPDAC) patients treated with systemic chemotherapy.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: We analyzed the prognostic impact of serum cfbDNA dynamics of 13 patients with aPDAC receiving mFOLFIRINOX (FFX) before treatment initiation and after two chemotherapy cycles. We validated the findings in the samples of 47 patients with locally advanced pancreatic cancer from the NEOLAP-AIO-PAK-0113 trial.
RESULTS: Decreased cfbDNA during FFX treatment was associated with improved PFS (14.3 vs. 2.9 months; p < 0.001) and OS (23.2 vs. 8.4 months; p = 0.006) in the exploratory cohort. Equal or increased cfbDNA was associated with inferior OS in univariate analyses (HR, 7.74; 95% CI, 1.38-43.24; p = 0.020) and a model adjusted for CA-19-9 group (HR, 11.75; 95% CI, 1.87-73.85; p = 0.009). In the NEOLAP cohort, decreased cfbDNA was associated with improved PFS (12.4 vs. 8.7 months, p = 0.003) and OS (39.8 vs. 14.7 months, p = 0.001) in FFX treated patients, whereas in patients continuing on gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel (GnP), decreased cfbDNA was associated with shorter PFS (6.2 vs. 11.5 months, p < 0.001) and OS (12.9 vs. 18.8 months, p = 0.013).
CONCLUSIONS: cfbDNA dynamics may serve as blood-based biomarker for monitoring therapy response in aPDAC. Its treatment-dependent predictive impact may inform clinical decisions. These findings suggest therapy-specific host-microbiome-tumor interactions and warrant prospective validation.
CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: NCT02125136.

title: Targeting the microbiota-gut-brain axis in Alzheimer's and Parkinson´s disease: recent therapeutic approaches.
authors: Gries Manuela; Schäfer Karl-Herbert; Endres Kristina
summary_zh: 综述近一年靶向微生物-肠-脑轴治疗阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病的策略，指出临床转化受方法异质性等限制。
innovation: 系统总结近一年靶向微生物-肠-脑轴治疗阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病的最新策略 | 涵盖饮食、益生菌、后生元、代谢物、粪菌移植、光生物调节及靶向代谢治疗等多类干预
limitation: 方法学异质性、个体间差异及缺乏标准化方案限制临床应用 | 需精心设计的临床试验、标准化微生物组分析和多组学整合
study_object: 人类 + 肠道微生物组 + 多组学/微生物组分析（综述）
disease: 阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病
abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Parkinson's disease (PD) are the most common neurodegenerative disorders with limited disease-modifying treatment options. Evidence suggests that the microbiota-gut-brain axis (MGBA) plays a role in these diseases by facilitating communication between the gut and the central nervous system. Associations have been found between altered gut microbiota composition and function, impaired barrier integrity, dysregulated metabolite production, and immune activation to neuroinflammation and progressive neurodegeneration.
AREAS COVERED: This review summarizes and critically assesses recent studies from the past year to provide an updated overview of therapeutic strategies targeting the MGBA in both diseases. We discuss dietary interventions, probiotics, postbiotics, microbial metabolites, and approaches targeting gut barrier function. We also highlight strategies such as fecal transplantation, photobiomodulation, and PD-targeted metabolism therapies using butyrate and resistant starch.
EXPERT OPINION: While these interventions have shown promising results in preclinical and early clinical trials, their clinical application is limited by methodological heterogeneity, interindividual variability and a lack of standardized protocols. Successful implementation requires carefully designed clinical trials, particularly longitudinal studies of presymptomatic cohorts, standardized microbiome analyses, and integrated multi-omics approaches to elucidate causal relations and facilitate personalized treatment strategies.

title: Schizophrenia-associated gut microbiota are linked to reduced colonic PRODH expression and behavioral changes in mice.
authors: Park Keontae; Joo Min-Kyung; Lee Im-Ho; Woo Jeong-Hwa; Park Hee-Seo et al.
summary_zh: 将精神分裂症患者粪菌移植给小鼠，发现肠道菌群改变与结肠PRODH表达降低、高脯氨酸血症及行为异常相关。
innovation: 发现精神分裂症相关肠道菌群与结肠PRODH表达降低及高脯氨酸血症的关联 | 鉴定出五种细菌组成的候选菌群可重现行为改变和代谢异常
study_object: 人类精神分裂症患者粪便/小鼠肠道 + 粪便样本 + 粪菌移植和转录组学
abstract: Schizophrenia (SCZ) is a chronic neuropsychiatric disorder whose biological basis remains incompletely understood. Growing evidence implicates the gut-brain axis in SCZ, but the host pathways through which disease-associated microbiota may influence behavior remain unclear. Here, we examined whether the gut microbiota from patients with SCZ is associated with behavioral and metabolic alterations in male C57BL/6N mice. Fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) from patients with SCZ was associated with impaired short-term recognition memory, reduced social novelty preference, and decreased prepulse inhibition in recipient mice. Transcriptomic profiling of colonic tissue identified reduced expression of Prodh, which encodes proline dehydrogenase (PRODH), together with elevated plasma proline levels. Comparative microbiome analyses identified a five-species candidate consortium associated with the SCZ donor microbiome - Escherichia fergusonii, Shigella sonnei, Morganella morganii, Citrobacter freundii, and Enterococcus faecalis. Oral administration of this five-species mixture (5-SM) was associated with similar behavioral changes, reduced colonic PRODH expression, and hyperprolinemia in mice. Together, these findings support a possible association between schizophrenia-associated changes in the gut microbiota, altered intestinal proline metabolism, and behavioral changes in mice.

title: Antibiotic intervention reshapes gut microbiome and modulates deoxynivalenol-induced gut - liver axis disturbances.
authors: Li Fangfang; Hu Yafan; Tai Bowen; Huangfu Bingxin; He Xiaoyun et al.
summary_zh: 小鼠实验表明DON经破坏肠道屏障和菌群内毒素信号致肝损伤，抗生素重塑菌群并减轻该肝损伤。
innovation: 揭示抗生素干预重塑肠道菌群可减轻DON诱导的肝损伤 | 发现ABX治疗使菌群与肝脏炎症标志物关联解耦 | 明确LPS-TLR4/MyD88信号在DON肝毒性中的作用
study_object: 小鼠/肠道和肝脏样本/16S rRNA测序及微生物组分析
disease: DON诱导的肝损伤和肠道屏障损伤
abstract: Deoxynivalenol (DON) is a prevalent foodborne mycotoxin, and its toxicity is closely associated with gut-liver axis dysfunction. However, the role of antibiotic-induced gut microbiome modulation in DON-induced intestinal and hepatic injury remains unclear. In this study, mice were exposed to DON with or without antibiotic (ABX) treatment for 4 weeks to investigate the contribution of gut microbiome to DON toxicity. DON exposure significantly impaired growth performance and induced hepatic injury, as evidenced by increased serum alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), and endotoxin (LPS) levels, accompanied by systemic inflammatory responses. Mechanistically, DON disrupted gut microbiome homeostasis, reduced microbial diversity, and compromised intestinal barrier integrity, leading to enhanced translocation of bacterial endotoxins into circulation. Importantly, ABX treatment was associated with reduced DON-induced hepatic injury, despite further impairment of intestinal epithelial integrity. This effect was associated with gut microbiome remodeling, decreased abundance of pro-inflammatory and LPS-associated bacterial taxa, and altered LPS-TLR4/MyD88-related inflammatory signaling responses in the liver. Moreover, correlation analysis revealed weakened associations between specific microbial genera and hepatic inflammatory markers in the ABX-treated group, suggesting a decoupling of microbiome-liver inflammatory crosstalk. Collectively, these findings suggest that DON-induced hepatotoxicity involves intestinal barrier impairment and gut microbiome-associated endotoxin signaling. ABX reshapes gut microbial communities and modulates LPS-related hepatic inflammatory responses, highlighting the potential role of the gut-liver axis in mycotoxin-associated toxicity.

title: Cancer immunotherapy under immune pressure: Mechanisms of resistance and the shift toward precision immune engineering.
authors: Anwer Muneera
summary_zh: 综述免疫治疗耐药机制，提出耐药是免疫压力的适应性后果，并探讨精准免疫工程策略。
innovation: 提出耐药应理解为治疗性免疫压力的适应性后果 | 将精准免疫工程定义为基于肿瘤生物学、免疫背景和预测生物标志物的个性化免疫治疗策略的合理设计
study_object: 肿瘤患者/肿瘤微环境/综述
abstract: Cancer immunotherapy has transformed the treatment landscape across multiple malignancies; however, durable responses remain limited to a subset of patients due to the emergence of intrinsic and acquired resistance. Increasing evidence suggests that therapeutic immune pressure itself acts as a selective force that shapes tumour evolution, driving the outgrowth of resistant clones. In this review, we synthesise current understanding of the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying resistance to major immunotherapeutic modalities, including immune checkpoint inhibitors, adoptive cell therapies, and cancer vaccines. We discuss tumour-intrinsic alterations such as defects in antigen presentation and immune signalling pathways, alongside tumour-extrinsic factors including immunosuppressive cell populations, metabolic constraints, and microbiome-mediated modulation. We further examine how these mechanisms converge within the tumour microenvironment to limit therapeutic efficacy. Emerging strategies to overcome resistance are highlighted, including rational combination therapies, next-generation engineered cellular platforms, and precision-guided approaches enabled by multi-omics profiling and artificial intelligence. Collectively, we propose that resistance should be understood as an adaptive consequence of therapeutic immune pressure. Building upon the principles of cancer immunoediting, we discuss how precision immune engineering, the rational design of personalised immunotherapeutic strategies informed by tumour biology, immune context, and predictive biomarkers, may be used to anticipate and overcome evolutionary escape mechanisms.

title: Characterizing the role of the gut microbiota-inflammation-brain axis in major depressive disorder: an integrative multi-omics study.
authors: Zhao Wenming; Zhu Dao-Min; Zhao Xufeng; Zhu Shukun; Fang Jie et al.
summary_zh: 整合多组学比较60例抑郁症患者与70例健康对照的肠道菌群、炎症因子、脑功能连接及临床特征，并揭示菌群-炎症-脑轴关联。
innovation: 首次综合探究抑郁症中肠道菌群、炎症、脑功能与临床特征的潜在关系 | 通过序列中介分析揭示Blautia减少→IL-1β升高→额顶区功能异常→临床症状的路径
study_object: 人类抑郁症患者和健康对照的肠道菌群、炎症因子和脑功能连接（多组学）
abstract:
BACKGROUND: Gut microbial dysbiosis and inflammation have been implicated in the pathophysiology of major depressive disorder (MDD). However, no attempts have been made to comprehensively investigate the potential relationship between gut microbiota, inflammation, brain function, and clinical features in MDD.
METHODS: We conducted an integrative multi-omics study to examine the multi-dimensional differences in gut microbiome, inflammatory cytokines, brain functional connectivity, and clinical features between 60 MDD patients and 70 healthy controls. Furthermore, the potential associations between these multi-omics alterations were assessed using correlation and serial mediation analyses.
RESULTS: MDD patients exhibited both depleted beneficial gut microbes and enriched detrimental bacteria, elevated interleukin-1 beta (IL-1β) level, a mix of decreased and increased functional connectivity of multiple brain regions. More important, we found that decreased abundance of anti-inflammatory bacterium (i.e., Blautia) led to increased IL-1β level, which in turn resulted in functional abnormalities in fronto-parietal regions that were associated with clinical symptoms and executive dysfunction.
CONCLUSION: Our findings may corroborate the gut microbiota-inflammation-brain axis hypothesis in depression, as well as highlight the potential use of targeting gut microbiota as anti-inflammatory intervention strategies in the prevention or treatment for MDD patients.

title: Skin Microbiome Metabolism in Cutaneous Microenvironments: Implications for Skin Health and Disease.
authors: Li Yue; Wang Yu; Huang Xinyu; Yang Lan; Wu Rourou et al.
summary_zh: 综述皮肤表面微生物代谢活动，探讨疾病相关皮肤代谢微环境变化，评估微生物代谢物的转化意义。
innovation: 系统阐明皮肤屏障、微生物群与表面代谢物间的相互作用 | 批判性评估微生物组衍生代谢物及干预措施的转化潜力与局限
study_object: 人类皮肤表面微生物组
abstract: The human skin surface harbors a complex ecosystem in which epidermal cells, resident microbiota, and surface metabolites cooperate to maintain a stable barrier against external stressors. Disruption of host or microbial metabolism at this interface is closely associated with impaired epidermal barrier integrity and the development of localized skin diseases. Such conditions can drive microbial dysbiosis and metabolic imbalance, leading to altered skin physiology and pathological manifestations. These changes arise from abnormal host secretions, including those from sebaceous glands, sweat glands, and keratinocytes, and are further shaped by shifts in microbial communities and their metabolites. This review focuses on microbial metabolic activity at the skin surface, examines disease-associated changes in the cutaneous metabolic microenvironment, and critically evaluates the physiological and translational relevance of microbiota-derived metabolites. By systematically elucidating the interactions among the skin barrier, skin microbiota, and surface metabolites, we further assess the translational potential and current limitations of microbiome-derived metabolites and microbiome-based interventions.

title: Gut microbiota from adolescents with social anxiety disorder is associated with behavioral alterations and metabolic changes in the medial prefrontal cortex.
authors: Lai Junyu; Yang Beibei; Ju Peijun; Sun Ying; Sun Xiujia et al.
summary_zh: 通过粪菌移植将社交焦虑障碍青少年肠道菌群移植给大鼠，发现其引发焦虑样行为和内侧前额叶代谢改变。
innovation: 采用粪菌移植将SAD患者肠道菌群移植至大鼠，验证其行为与代谢影响 | 结合16S rDNA测序和非靶向代谢组学分析内侧前额叶皮层代谢变化
limitation: 未建立因果关系，需进一步研究阐明机制
study_object: 人类青少年粪便样本及受体大鼠/肠道菌群/16S rDNA扩增子测序和非靶向代谢组学
abstract:
BACKGROUND: Social anxiety disorder (SAD) is a prevalent and burdensome neuropsychiatric disorder characterised by pronounced and persistent fear and anxiety in social situations. While evidence links gut microbiota to neuropsychiatric disorders, its role in SAD remains poorly understood.
AIM: In this study, we aimed to investigate the potential involvement of gut microbiota in SAD pathophysiology through fecal microbiota transplantation.
METHOD: We collected demographic data and fecal samples from 40 first-episode, comorbidity-free, and drug-naive adolescent patients with SAD, along with 32 demographically matched healthy controls. Fecal samples underwent 16S rDNA amplicon sequencing and were pooled for transplantation into neonatal rats from postnatal day 1 through late adolescence. Recipient rats were evaluated with behavioral tests, microbiota detection, and non-targeted metabolomics of the medial prefrontal cortex.
RESULT: Patients with SAD displayed alterations in gut microbiota composition. Rats colonized with SAD-associated microbiota exhibited anxiety-like behaviors and reduced social novelty preference, alongside microbial profiles partially overlapping with those of patients. These behavioral changes were correlated with microbiota differences, and distinct metabolic alterations were detected in the medial prefrontal cortex of SAD-colonized rats.
CONCLUSION: Gut microbiota from adolescents with SAD is associated with behavioral and metabolic alterations in a rodent model, suggesting a potential role of the gut-brain axis in SAD. Further studies are warranted to establish causality and elucidate underlying mechanisms.

title: Linking oral microbiota to clinic air during ultrasonic scaling: Quantitative sequencing and CFD modeling reveal pathogenic aerosol emissions, infection risk, and control strategies.
authors: Jin Yongjun; Liu Jia; Liu Zhijian; Yuan Yaohua; Cui Haihang et al.
summary_zh: 研究结合宏基因组测序与CFD模拟，量化超声洁牙产生的病原气溶胶排放、感染风险及通风控制策略。
innovation: 首次将患者口腔微生物组与诊室气溶胶直接关联，识别共享核心病原菌群 | 结合绝对定量与粒径分辨采样确定病原气溶胶排放强度及粒径分布 | 基于真实病原浓度和粒径谱的CFD模拟提出动态通风控制策略
study_object: 人类患者口腔与诊室空气及表面样本，采用宏基因组、16S rRNA和ITS扩增子测序及CFD模拟
abstract: Microbial aerosols from dental procedures pose a recognized yet unquantified airborne infection risk. During ultrasonic scaling, we performed multi-site sampling (saliva, air, surfaces) and combined metagenomics with quantitative 16S rRNA and ITS amplicon sequencing to profile viral, bacterial, and fungal communities. Using size-resolved aerosol sampling and absolute quantification, we determined the emission strength and size distribution of pathogenic bacterial aerosols (PBA), which were key inputs for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations performed at ventilation velocities of 0.1, 0.2, and 0.4 m/s, corresponding to air exchange per hour (ACH) of 2.4, 4.7, and 9.4 h-1, respectively. We first linked patient oral microbiota to clinic aerosols, identifying a shared core of 51 viral, 55 bacterial, and 23 fungal families, of which three bacterial families (Streptococcaceae, Pasteurellaceae, Nocardiaceae) were pathogenic. The emission strength of PBA was ∼3.06 × 103 copies/min, with 66.7% concentrated in the 2.1∼4.7 μm fraction, a size associated with higher deposition in the lower respiratory tract. CFD simulations, fed with real pathogen concentrations and aerodynamic size spectra, revealed that increasing ACH from 0.1 to 0.4 m/s reduced PBA suspension (-26.4%) and surface deposition (-12.7%) during scaling, lowering the inhalation infection risk (IIR) at the dentist's position by 80.8% and keeping overall IIR below 25%. After scaling, lower velocity favours particle removal, supporting a dynamic ventilation strategy (high during treatment, low afterwards). This integrated framework provides a direct scientific basis for infection control in dental operatories.

title: Phytochemicals in colorectal cancer therapy: emerging mechanisms, translational opportunities, and global research evolution.
authors: Adil Muhammad; Dawe Gavin Stewart; Subramaniyan Vetriselvan
summary_zh: 通过文献计量与叙述性综述分析2000-2025年植物化学物治疗结直肠癌研究，揭示机制与转化趋势。
innovation: 结合文献计量映射与叙述性综述揭示植物化学物研究演变 | 识别影响未来发展的五个领域包括微生物组-免疫互作和新型递送系统 | 将生物材料设计视为领域组成部分而非辅助。
study_object: 植物化学物/结直肠癌/文献计量分析
abstract: Colorectal cancer is still a leading cause of cancer morbidity and mortality in the world. This is a reflection of the limitations of current chemotherapy and the need for additional therapeutic strategies. Phytochemicals from plants have been of great interest recently because they can affect several pathways involved in cancer. In this review, we combine bibliometric mapping with a narrative synthesis to discuss the changing nature of phytochemical research in colorectal cancer. A total of 1029 records from Web of Science, covering January 2000 to December 2025, were analyzed using VOSviewer, Bibliometrix, and CiteSpace. The trend of publications is steadily increasing, particularly since 2020. Keyword mapping revealed some common themes, particularly apoptosis, flavonoids, curcumin, quercetin, network pharmacology, nanoparticles, and ferroptosis. The literature shows a transition from early screening studies to more in-depth mechanistic and translational studies. From the bibliometric findings, five areas are identified that might influence the future development of the field. These areas include modulation of multiple signaling pathways, regulated cell death, interactions between the gut microbiome and immune system, overcoming chemoresistance, and innovative delivery systems to enhance bioavailability. Taken together, these findings suggest that phytochemicals act as multi-target compounds rather than single cytotoxic agents with promising potential in combination therapies for colorectal cancer. Materials and delivery research accounts for a rising share of this corpus, increasing from 0.0% of records published between 2000 and 2011 to 16.0% of those published between 2020 and 2025, and nanoparticles emerge as a major keyword cluster although no materials term appears in the search string. The review therefore treats biomaterial design as a component of the field rather than as an adjunct to it, covering polymeric, lipid, inorganic, biomimetic and stimuli-responsive platforms against a common set of performance criteria.

title: Myeloid cell reprogramming drives enhanced defense against Streptococcus pneumoniae lung infection following exposure to commensal Prevotella.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
authors: Stoner Sara N; Larson Eric D; Fulte Sam; Shaw Steven C; Fish Erin R et al.
summary_zh: 研究通过单细胞RNA测序揭示，预先暴露于黑色素普雷沃菌可重编程髓系细胞转录程序，增强小鼠对肺炎链球菌的清除能力。
innovation: 首次利用单细胞RNA测序定义普雷沃菌暴露后肺炎链球菌感染中髓系细胞转录免疫特征 | 发现中性粒细胞TNFR2介导的TNF信号对增强抗菌功能至关重要 | 揭示CCR2依赖的单核细胞来源巨噬细胞及Cxcl3+成熟亚群在改善防御中的选择性富集
study_object: 小鼠/肺/单细胞RNA测序
abstract: Clinical data link the prevalent respiratory tract anaerobe Prevotella with reduced pneumonia mortality, but the mechanisms directing Prevotella regulation of lung immune homeostasis are unclear. Here, single-cell RNA sequencing was employed to define the transcriptional immune signatures underlying improved clearance of Streptococcus pneumoniae following lung exposure to Prevotella melaninogenica. Overall, we observed a substantial shift in myeloid cell transcriptional programming from interferon-dominant to a more antibacterial profile in S. pneumoniae-infected mice after pre-exposure to P. melaninogenica, correlating with increased macrophage and neutrophil phagocytosis of S. pneumoniae and improved pathogen clearance. In neutrophils, tumor necrosis factor (TNF) signaling through TNFR2 was essential for increased antimicrobial function. Moreover, improved defense required CCR2-dependent monocyte-derived macrophages, with selective enrichment of more a mature Cxcl3+ population which was distinct from the hallmark S. pneumoniae-associated C1qa+ population enriched in the absence of effective clearance. Together, these findings inform the myeloid cell transcriptional changes associated with natural infection resistance mediated by pulmonary microbial exposures.

title: Differential effects of prenatal depression and anxiety on infant sleep: dual-pathway mechanisms involving the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis and the gut-brain axis.
authors: Liu Can; Lin Yuan; Li Ye; Liu Ting; Yang Sukang et al.
summary_zh: 产前抑郁和焦虑通过HPA轴与肠道菌群-色氨酸代谢双通路影响婴儿睡眠，并构建预测模型。
innovation: 揭示产前抑郁与焦虑对婴儿睡眠的差异化双通路机制 | 整合多组学与机器学习构建婴儿睡眠障碍早期风险预测工具
study_object: 母婴队列的婴儿粪便（胎便）和脐带血，采用16S rRNA测序和液相色谱-串联质谱技术
disease: 婴儿睡眠障碍、产前抑郁、产前焦虑
sample_size: n=2288母婴对，其中112对子队列进行多组学分析
abstract:
STUDY OBJECTIVES: Prenatal psychological distress is associated with adverse offspring outcomes, including infant sleep disturbances (ISD) and altered gut microbiota, yet the mediating roles of the neonatal gut microbiome and tryptophan metabolism remain underexplored.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This prospective birth cohort study enrolled 2288 mother-infant pairs, using questionnaires to assess prenatal anxiety/depression and infant sleep patterns up to 12 months. A 112-pair sub-cohort underwent multi-omics analyses: meconium microbiota profiling via 16S rRNA sequencing and cord blood tryptophan metabolite quantification via liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression, mediation analyses, and XGBoost modeling were applied.
RESULTS: Prenatal depression alone was a significant risk factor for ISD (fully adjusted OR = 1.53, 95% CI: 1.04-2.25), with a stronger effect in female infants (OR = 2.11, p = .022). Cord blood cortisol partially mediated this link (Average Causal Mediation Effect = -7.47, 95% CI: [-14.82, -0.12], p = .048). Prenatal anxiety correlated with reduced meconium microbial alpha-diversity, lower Bifidobacterium abundance, and decreased 3-HAA/serotonin levels, which were associated with sleep disturbance; serial mediation confirmed the gut microbiota-tryptophan metabolism pathway. The XGBoost predictive model achieved an AUC of 0.727, with microbial diversity, Streptococcus abundance, dopamine, and 3-HAA as top contributors.
CONCLUSIONS: This study identifies distinct mediating pathways for depression and anxiety, providing targets for personalized infant sleep health interventions. Statement of Significance This study reveals that prenatal depression and anxiety impair infant sleep through distinct biological pathways. Depression was associated with elevated fetal cortisol (HPA axis), while anxiety may influence the neonatal gut microbiome and its production of sleep-regulating tryptophan metabolites. These findings contribute to a novel dual-pathway model that helps clarify previously unresolved mechanistic questions. By integrating these biomarkers into a machine learning model, we offer a translational tool for early risk prediction. The work bridges a critical gap between epidemiological observation and biological mechanism, paving the way for personalized interventions-targeting stress hormones for depression or gut health for anxiety-to improve infant neurodevelopmental outcomes.

title: Nanoformulated Curcumin Ameliorates Ulcerative Colitis via Gut Microbiota Modulation and Barrier Function Restoration.
journal: The American journal of Chinese medicine
authors: Xie Yin-Zhuo; Sun Chen-Xi; Fu Tian-Tian; Jin Zheng; Nalinratana Nonthaneth et al.
summary_zh: 研究纳米姜黄素对DSS诱导小鼠结肠炎的预防作用，通过16S测序和代谢组学发现其调节菌群和短链脂肪酸，FMT验证因果性。
innovation: 揭示纳米姜黄素通过调节肠道菌群及其代谢产物预防溃疡性结肠炎 | 整合16S rRNA测序与非靶向代谢组学关联菌群变化与抗炎结果 | 通过粪菌移植验证纳米姜黄素重塑菌群的因果保护作用
study_object: 小鼠 + 粪便/肠道样本 + 16S rRNA测序与非靶向代谢组学
abstract: The gut microbiota is increasingly recognized as a key mediator of the anticolitis effects of curcumin (CUR). However, the clinical translation of this promising activity is severely hampered by CUR's low solubility and poor bioavailability. Although nanoencapsulation represents a promising strategy to address these limitations, the preventive effect of nanocurcumin (nano-CUR) against colitis remains largely unexplored. The present study aimed to elucidate the preventive effects of nano-CUR on intestinal barrier function, gut microbiota composition, and metabolic profiles in a murine model of dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced colitis. The results demonstrated that pre-supplementation of nano-CUR significantly ameliorated disease severity, attenuated intestinal barrier disruption, and suppressed colonic inflammation in mice with DSS-induced colitis. Mechanistically, integrated 16S rRNA sequencing and untargeted metabolomics demonstrated that nano-CUR-restored microbial homeostasis and enhanced the production of short-chain fatty acids, linking microbial shifts to anti-inflammatory outcomes. Fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) further validated the causal role of the nano-CUR-remodeled microbiota in conferring protection. Collectively, these findings decipher the mechanism by which nano-CUR interacts with the gut microbiota, confirming that dietary nano-CUR consumption protects against ulcerative colitis by modulating the gut microbiome and its metabolic output.

title: Sex- and Time-Resolved Physiological and Gut Ecosystem Responses to a Food-Grade Microbiome-Targeted Intervention in Collegiate Endurance Athletes.
authors: Zhang Meng; Ge Le; Liu Kaiyang; Liu Yanrong; Zhao Guolin et al.
summary_zh: 一项随机双盲安慰剂对照试验研究益生菌-酵母提取物对耐力运动员生理和肠道生态的影响，发现与设备估计最大摄氧量等指标变化相关，多组学揭示性别和阶段差异。
innovation: 整合可穿戴表型、临床评估、粪便宏基因组和代谢组学多组学分析 | 采用性别和时间分辨的分析框架 | 间接效应模型提名候选微生物特征与宿主结局的关联
limitation: 长期扩展部分为探索性且需确认 | 亚组、长期、网络和间接效应结果均为假设生成性
study_object: 大学生耐力运动员 + 粪便 + 宏基因组和代谢组学
abstract: Endurance athletes experience sustained physiological demands during high-volume training, yet evidence for microbiome-targeted interventions in real-world settings remains limited. We conducted a two-stage, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in 150 athletes allocated 2:1 to combined probiotics-yeast extract (CPYE) or placebo for 6 weeks; 44 completers confirmed for the 12th Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region University Games entered an exploratory 6-week extension with intensified training. Integrating wearable-derived phenotyping, field-based cardiorespiratory indices, clinical assessments, fecal metagenomics, and metabolomics, we found that during the randomized short-term phase, CPYE was associated with changes in device-estimated maximal oxygen uptake, exercise heart-rate indices, lactate, and redox biomarkers versus placebo. Exploratory sex-stratified analyses suggested heterogeneous response patterns, while the selected long-term extension indicated time-dependent changes requiring confirmation. Multi-omics identified sex- and phase-associated differences in microbial taxa, functions, metabolites, and network topology. Indirect-effect models nominated candidate features (rmlD, PISD-linked phosphatidylethanolamine pathways, Bacteroides ovatus, and folate-related functions) as potential indirect correlates of host outcomes. These findings support further evaluation of CPYE-associated responses in collegiate endurance athletes; subgroup, long-term, network, and indirect-effect results are hypothesis-generating.

title: Toward "Obesityomics": Domain-Specific Omics in Precision Obesity Medicine with a Brief AI Perspective.
journal: Obesity reviews : an official journal of the International Association for the Study of Obesity
authors: Samra Nadia Abu; Suliman Sara G I; Al-Hadad Mohammed; Boomsma Dorret I; Alhantoobi Fadwa et al.
summary_zh: 本文通过叙述性综述分析“肥胖组学”各领域对理解和管理肥胖的贡献，并简要探讨人工智能的应用。
innovation: 提出“肥胖组学”作为将组学模态与正确问题对齐的实用方法，而非数据集合并 | 强调人工智能应与质量控制、特征选择和适度数据整合结合使用 | 按领域（单组学）分析各层面对疾病分类、因果通路和生物标志物的细化作用
study_object: 肥胖人群 + 未描述 + 多组学（基因组学、表观基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学和脂质组学、微生物组科学）
abstract:
BACKGROUND: Obesity's global rise has outpaced the effectiveness of "one-size-fits-all" prevention and treatment strategies. The promise of precision medicine lies in addressing the etiological and biological diversity of obesity and transforming it into actionable endotypes.
OBJECTIVES: In a narrative review, we analyze "obesityomics," looking at the contributions each omics layer makes to understanding and managing obesity. The areas we evaluate are genomics (heritability, polygenic risk, and monogenic forms), epigenomics (development and environment imprinting), transcriptomics (tissue-specific programs of adipose, liver, muscle, and hypothalamus), proteomics (signaling networks and adipokines), metabolomics and lipidomics (fuel partitioning, lipotoxicity, and metabolic inflection points), and microbiome science (metabolites, host-microbe interactions, and microbial ecology). Our domain-by-domain (single-omics) approach demonstrates how disease taxonomy, causal pathways, and biomarkers can be refined and targeted therapeutically.
DISCUSSION: We argue that "obesityomics" is a pragmatic approach to aligning omics modalities to the right questions at the right time, not a wholesale merger of datasets. Artificial intelligence (AI)-including machine learning and deep learning-should be used in conjunction with quality control, feature selection, modest data integration, and obesity intervention prediction. Among the key challenges in managing sensitive multilayer data are harmonization, standardization, reproducibility, equitable representation, and governance. The translation priorities include prospective studies related to patient-centered outcomes, biomarker panels that are clinic-ready, interoperability standards, and cost-effectiveness evaluations.
CONCLUSION: The review maps concrete steps to assist people with obesity in making better choices by identifying what each omics domain excels at and introducing a brief AI perspective.

title: Comparative transcriptional network analysis reveals ecological specialization in infant-associated species of Bifidobacterium.
authors: Melis-Arcos Felipe; Arita Masanori; Garrido Daniel
summary_zh: 整合泛基因组与转录因子结合位点推断，比较三种婴儿双歧杆菌调控网络，发现物种特异性调控差异。
innovation: 整合泛基因组与转录因子结合位点推断，在超过300个基因组尺度上重建并比较三种婴儿双歧杆菌的转录调控网络 | 发现调控互作常涉及附属基因，且调控子组成和基因组流行率存在物种依赖性差异
limitation: 预测的调控互作和调控子组成仅为计算推断，需实验验证；仅FucR的附属靶标比例有显著差异，其他调控因子差异为描述性
study_object: 婴儿肠道双歧杆菌（B. longum subsp. infantis、B. breve、B. longum subsp. longum）/ 基因组 / 泛基因组与转录调控网络分析
abstract:
UNLABELLED: Bifidobacterium species are important microorganisms in the infant gut microbiota displaying substantial genomic diversity, yet how this variability is reflected in transcriptional regulatory architecture remains an open question. Here, we integrated pangenome analysis with transcription factor binding site inference and network-based approaches to compare regulatory architectures across Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis, Bifidobacterium breve, and B. longum subsp. longum using over 300 high-quality genomes. All three species exhibited open pangenomes, with regulatory interactions frequently involving accessory genes. Inferred network metrics were compared with score-randomized controls across motif-score thresholds. Increasing score stringency reduced network size while increasing the number of detected communities, indicating greater fragmentation of the retained networks rather than a measured increase in modularity. NrdR showed an intermediate overlap in the Clusters of Orthologous Groups (COG) category sets represented among its predicted targets and species-dependent target prevalence. HMO-related regulators (FucR, NanR, and NagR) differed descriptively between Bifidobacterium infantis and B. breve, the two species included in the complete three-regulator comparison, in predicted target counts, represented COG category sets, and genomic-prevalence patterns; only FucR showed a significant difference in accessory-target fraction. These findings identify species-dependent differences in predicted regulon composition and genomic prevalence and provide testable hypotheses about how regulatory architecture may relate to ecological specialization in the infant gut.
IMPORTANCE: Bifidobacterium species are among the most abundant microorganisms in the breast-fed infant gut microbiota, where they display distinct patterns of genomic diversification and host association. However, the transcriptional regulatory mechanisms underlying these species-specific differences remain incompletely characterized. Here, we reconstructed and compared genome-scale transcriptional regulatory networks across three infant-associated Bifidobacterium species, integrating pangenome structure with transcription factor binding site inference across more than 300 genomes. Our analyses identified predicted regulatory interactions involving accessory genes and species-specific differences in network structure, regulon composition, and target prevalence. These associations provide hypotheses for experimental studies of how gene content and regulatory architecture may contribute to niche adaptation. This pangenome-scale framework can support the prioritization of regulatory hypotheses for future functional studies of infant-associated Bifidobacterium.

title: Association of quantitative sputum Candida load with respiratory dysbiosis and airway inflammation in suspected invasive pulmonary candidiasis.
authors: Wang Guangli; Zhang Ningqing; Peng Yanfeng; Wen Xu; Chen Xianlian et al.
summary_zh: 本研究对140例疑似侵袭性肺念珠菌病患者进行痰定量培养和mNGS，发现高念珠菌载量与呼吸道菌群失调、炎症及住院延长相关。
innovation: 整合痰定量培养与宏基因组测序分析念珠菌载量与呼吸道微生态及炎症的关联 | 揭示高念珠菌载量与经典细菌病原体负相关的独特失调特征 | 构建九物种微生物组特征模型有效区分可能与疑似侵袭性肺念珠菌病
limitation: 探索性研究，样本量有限 | 需在更大规模多中心队列中进一步验证
study_object: 住院患者/痰液/定量真菌培养与宏基因组二代测序
disease: 疑似侵袭性肺念珠菌病
abstract:
UNLABELLED: The clinical significance of Candida species isolation from sputum remains ambiguous due to the colonization-infection dilemma. Integrating quantitative culture with microbiome profiling may clarify its role, yet systematic evidence is scarce. In this exploratory study (June 2023-June 2026), we enrolled 140 hospitalized patients suspected of invasive pulmonary candidiasis (IPC) and stratified them into possible IPC (n = 36), probable IPC (n = 71), and negative control (n = 33) groups based on clinical criteria. All underwent quantitative fungal culture of sputum and metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS). Patients were stratified by sputum Candida species load into low (<105 CFU/mL), high (≥105 CFU/mL), and negative control (0 CFU/mL) groups. We investigated associations between Candida species burden, respiratory microbiota, local inflammation (IL-8), and clinical outcomes. Higher Candida species load was significantly associated with prolonged hospitalization, elevated sputum IL-8, an increased microbial dysbiosis index, and depletion of key commensals (e.g., Neisseria, Prevotella, Rothia, Streptococcus, and Veillonella). Counterintuitively, it correlated negatively with several classic bacterial pathogens (such as Acinetobacter baumannii, Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Mycobacterium tuberculosis, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa). A random forest model identified a nine-species microbiome signature that effectively discriminated probable from possible IPC (AUC, 0.877; 95% CI, 0.662-0.944). In patients with suspected IPC, higher sputum Candida species load is associated with exacerbated respiratory dysbiosis and airway inflammation. Quantitative Candida species assessment combined with microbiome signatures may serve as a complementary tool for stratifying disease severity and ecological disruption, meriting further validation in larger, multicenter cohorts.
IMPORTANCE: Respiratory specimens dominate clinical fungal cultures, yet interpreting the role of Candida spp. in sputum remains a diagnostic dilemma. Here, by integrating quantitative culture with metagenomic sequencing, we show that a high sputum Candida species load is a marker of profound ecological disruption. High Candida species burden was associated with significant depletion of key commensals, an elevated dysbiosis index, and heightened local inflammation. Counterintuitively, it correlated negatively with several classic bacterial pathogens, revealing a distinct dysbiotic signature. Moreover, a microbiome-based model accurately discriminated patients with probable invasive pulmonary candidiasis. Our findings suggest that quantitative sputum Candida species load, interpreted within the context of the microbial community, may be a practical biomarker for identifying patients with significant respiratory dysbiosis and inflammation, offering a path toward more refined, ecology-informed therapeutic strategies.

title: A global atlas of the gut virome reveals subtype-specific and functional alterations in irritable bowel syndrome.
authors: Xie Peiwei; Luo Mei; Fan Jiahui; Xiong Lishou
summary_zh: 整合全球11队列1104样本构建IBS肠道病毒组图谱，揭示亚型与地理差异及功能基因特征，机器学习可稳健分型。
innovation: 构建全球IBS肠道病毒组综合图谱，覆盖多地理区域和多亚型 | 发现病毒组功能上富集碳代谢和神经递质前体合成辅助代谢基因及毒力/耐药基因 | 基于病毒特征的机器学习模型实现IBS亚型稳健分型（AUC=0.92）
study_object: 人类肠道病毒组，粪便样本，宏基因组和病毒样颗粒富集宏病毒组测序
disease: 肠易激综合征（IBS），包括腹泻型（IBS-D）、便秘型（IBS-C）和混合型（IBS-M）
abstract: The gut virome is a critical component of the microbiome-gut-brain axis; however, its role in irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) remains poorly understood due to limited sample sizes and geographic bias. We aimed to construct a comprehensive global atlas of the IBS gut virome to elucidate its composition, functional potential, and clinical relevance across diverse populations and IBS subtypes. We integrated multi-cohort data comprising 1,104 samples (790 IBS patients and 314 healthy controls) from 11 cohorts across 10 geographic regions. A standardized bioinformatic pipeline was employed to perform viral mining from metagenomic and virus-like particle-enriched metaviromic data. The IBS virome exhibited significant taxonomic alterations, with specific viral signatures distinguishing IBS-D, IBS-C, and IBS-M subtypes.
